requirements.evidence: All contract members are present: Queues properties/methods (app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:26-243) with view data accessQueue/accessGrants (Queues.php:213-224); Serve state and callNext with notices for InactiveQueueException/NoWaitingTicketsException, AuthorizationException not caught, and a 10/min limiter keyed on entity+user (app/Livewire/Entity/Serve.php:58-95); routes (routes/web.php:59-60); Members activeTab/setActiveTab with a whitelist (Members.php:55,73-78); tablist markup with invite UI only on the invites tab (members.blade.php:6-20); all lang keys in both locales; navbar links (default-page.blade.php:44-49). Rename re-derives the slug with Str::slug (Queues.php:150-155). Toggle uses a modal and no wire:confirm (queues.blade.php:99-121). Small gap: the waiting list shows priority only when > 0 (serve.blade.php:53-55), while the task asks for code, priority, issue time and channel on every row.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes go through CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket. #[Validate] is used on name/renameName (Queues.php:32,54), #[Locked] on entity/lastCalledTicketId, policies are used through authorize/Gate, and CHANGELOG plus docs/business-rules.md are updated. Deviations: Serve validates `mode` with an inline `$this->validate([...])` (Serve.php:70) instead of #[Validate]. toggleActive (Queues.php:179-186) has no `$this->authorize('update', $queue)` of its own, unlike the sibling actions; it depends on hydrate() and the action's internal check.

security.evidence: Every client id is resolved scoped to the entity: `$this->entity->queues()->findOrFail(...)` and `$this->entity->memberships()->findOrFail(...)` (Queues.php:107,131,143,179,190,229-230; Serve.php:68). hydrate() re-runs the manager check on every request (Queues.php:72-75). render() uses find() scoped to the entity, so a tampered accessQueueId discloses nothing (Queues.php:208-224). Waiting tickets are gated by `Gate::allows('call', $queue)` (Serve.php:131-136). All output is escaped with {{ }}. Minor gap: toggleActive does not authorize the resolved queue in the component itself (still protected by hydrate and by UpdateQueue).

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesTest.php covers the employee 403 on the route and the component, the list having no per-row actions, create/rename including duplicate-slug and blank errors, the toggle confirmation modal, grant/revoke with an audit log, foreign ids throwing ModelNotFoundException for each action, a tampered accessQueueId, and every action rejecting a manager demoted after mount. ServeTest.php covers call order, mode filtering, the 30-ticket cap, foreign/missing/ungranted selections, invalid mode, notices, the 403 without a grant, the locked lastCalledTicketId and rate limiting. Members/Navbar tests cover the tabs and links. The existing invite tests were adapted to the tab split, and their assertions were moved to the invites tab rather than removed.

simplicity.evidence: The change is mostly lean and reuses the domain actions and policies. One piece adds indirection that probably isn't needed: domainError() (Queues.php:276-284) discards the domain message and maps it to two custom keys using a heuristic (`mb_strlen($slug) <= 255`). accessGrants() loads every QueueAccess row and filters in PHP (Queues.php:250-254), which is acceptable at this scale.

readability.evidence: Names are clear, methods are small and PHPDoc explains the untrusted state (Queues.php:38-60, Serve.php:32-48). Modal markup follows the members page style. domainError's slug-length condition is hard to follow, and the rename fallback `$this->editingQueueId ?? $this->viewingQueueId ?? 0` (Queues.php:143) is implicit.

scope.evidence: Every file in the diff serves the task: two components, their views, routes, lang keys, navbar, Members tabs, docs/CHANGELOG and tests. The extra lang keys (serve_rate_limited, queues_slug_taken, etc.) support the required UI. No unrelated refactors.

issues.explanation: toggleActive() resolves the queue but never calls $this->authorize('update', $queue), unlike every sibling action; it relies on hydrate() and UpdateQueue's internal authorization instead of authorizing the resolved model in the action, which the Livewire policy requires.
The waiting list shows priority only for tickets with priority > 0, while the task asks for code, priority, issue time and channel on every row.
The public `mode` property is validated with an inline rule array instead of the project's #[Validate] attribute pattern.
domainError() replaces the domain's own messages with a heuristic mapping (slug present and <= 255 chars) that is hard to follow and may hide the real validation message.
Grants are loaded in full and filtered in PHP rather than queried directly; acceptable, but more code than needed.

review.summary: The change adds the Queues management page and the Serve panel, splits Members into tabs and adds the navbar links. Every client id is resolved scoped to the entity, all writes go through the domain actions, and tests are thorough, including tamper, demotion and authorization cases. Small gaps keep it from a clean approve: toggleActive does not authorize the resolved queue itself, priority is not shown on every waiting row, and there are minor convention/readability nits.
